name: Residual-based Leray relative-energy adapter certificate

statement.latest: \sup_{0\le t\le T}\|u(t)-v(t)\|_2^2\le e^{A_T}\left(e_0^2+\frac{B_T}{\nu}\right),\quad A_T=2\int_0^T\|\nabla v\|_\infty dt,\quad B_T=\int_0^T\|r\|_{H^{-1}}^2dt
statement.note_ascii: Leray-Hopf solution u is bounded in L2 from a smooth/piecewise-smooth comparison path v by exp(A)*(initial_error^2 + residual_Hminus1_L2t^2/nu)

definitions.u: Leray-Hopf weak solution of the declared periodic incompressible Navier-Stokes problem
definitions.v: continuous divergence-free comparison path with the regularity required by the relative-energy argument
definitions.r: equation residual v_t + P[(v.grad)v] - nu Delta v - Pf
definitions.A_T: twice the time integral of ||grad v||_infinity
definitions.B_T: time integral of the squared H^{-1} residual norm

parents.evidence: gives the adapter theorem once certified continuous-time residual summaries are available
for a P_K-supported terminal comparison path, the full L2 adapter error directly bounds the omitted terminal Fourier tail

name: Exact piecewise-linear enclosure of a floating-point RK4 tape

statement.latest: \text{binary64 RK4 nodes}\to\text{exact dyadic Leray-projected nodes}\to v_h(t)\to(\overline A_T,\overline B_T),\quad A_T\le\overline A_T,\;B_T\le\overline B_T
statement.note_ascii: reinterpret each recorded float exactly as a dyadic rational, project exactly onto divergence-free Fourier space, join nodes by an exact piecewise-linear path, integrate a rational residual polynomial exactly, and bound the gradient integral and exponential from above

definitions.v_h: exact rational continuous piecewise-linear K-supported divergence-free interpolation of the recorded RK4 nodes after exact Leray projection
definitions.A_bar: rigorous finite upper bound on 2 int ||grad v_h||_infinity obtained from a Fourier l1 majorant
definitions.B_bar: exact rational value/upper bound for int ||full equation residual of v_h||_{H^-1}^2 on the declared periodic Fourier convention
definitions.float_semantics: each binary64 component is treated as its exact IEEE-754 dyadic rational; no interval guess is made about the stored bit pattern

parents.evidence: the exact piecewise-linear construction supplies the A_T and B_T inputs required by the relative-energy adapter
affine Fourier coefficients make the quadratic Navier-Stokes residual degree at most two in each time cell, so its squared H^-1 norm integrates exactly as a degree-four rational polynomial
provides a concrete certified finite-tape-to-continuum comparison-path adapter for the declared finite run

origin.source: Construction and executable witness in github.com/morrocwi/readout-problem-navier-stokes/reproduction/checks/check_volume7_rk4_continuous_enclosure.py; 2026-09-10. Reusable implementation is mirrored in github.com/morrocwi/information-discrete-math.

claim_boundary: The finite enclosure construction is exact after capture of the stated binary64 tape and the continuum implication uses PROP-EPSC-13 at analytic Dr tier. Tightness and computational scaling at large K are separate questions.

name: Observable-to-continuum orthogonal composition certificate

definitions.rho_N: certified retained-state reconstruction radius modulo G
